facts.fact: 叙述者跳进Henry死去的洞穴坑，骨头在脚下嘎吱响；搭档Flint落在她身旁
facts.anchor: I hop down into the hole where Henry died, bones crunching under my feet.

facts.fact: 对手Ruby拔出匕首对准叙述者与Flint，要求交出两人的背包就放他们走
facts.anchor: she pulls out a dagger, aiming it at us

facts.fact: 对手Litheo告诉Ruby：Flint那条旧的机械腿就算用过也能卖thirty thousand nox
facts.anchor: Even used, those can go for thirty thousand nox.

facts.fact: 叙述者把头灯从红光切到白光直射Ruby的脸；Litheo完全没反应，因为他已失明
facts.anchor: clicking the dial to change my light from red to white

facts.fact: Litheo双手抓住从自己眼睛里长出的蘑菇梗往外拔，six-inch stalks带血和胶状黏液落地
facts.anchor: The six-inch stalks fall to the ground

facts.fact: 搭档Ruby把正在融化的Litheo从酸池里拽出来，自己的双手被酸灼伤出血，看着他化成泥
facts.anchor: Ruby kneels beside Litheo, her own hands bleeding from the acid

facts.fact: Voidling女守门人做完fiend-infection检查后要Eight nox入场费；Flint递上ten-nox note说Keep the change
facts.anchor:
“Eight nox to enter.”

Flint hands her a ten-nox note.

facts.fact: 叙述者在旅店二楼走廊喊Jade的名字，7号房门打开，Jade站在门后看着她
facts.anchor: But the doorknob turns, and a green-eyed, auburn-haired girl stares back at me.
